title: ZeroBlade
tagline: Bet on sports. Never lose your stake. Win rewards, or get your capital back: zero-loss betting.
description:
Zero Blade is a Zero-Loss Betting Platform that allows users to wager on sports events without risking their principal. Whether you win or lose, your capital is never lost. Instead, all user bets are pooled and staked into yield-generating DeFi protocols like SushiSwap, Morpho, or Yearn during the duration of the event.


When the event concludes, the yield earned during the staking period is distributed only among the users who placed correct predictions, while everyone else receives back their full initial stake. This system effectively turns betting into a capital-efficient DeFi game where your sports knowledge can earn you additional yield without the risk of losing your principal.

Winnings can be claimed after a 7-day cooldown, during which rewards are still accruing. A small protocol fee is deducted from the total yield (not principal), ensuring sustainability without hurting user capital. Zero Blade merges the thrill of betting with the reliability of yield farming in a secure, non-custodial and fun way.

How do we do it? It's simple, yet ingenious. When you place a bet on ZeroBlade, your funds aren't just sitting idle; they're instantly put to work. Our smart 

BettingProtocol forwards your stake directly to our powerful StakingHelper. This isn't just any helper; it's your personal DeFi investment manager, strategically designed to interact with the cutting-edge Katana ecosystem.

The StakingHelper is engineered for peak performance, ensuring your collective stakes generate the best possible APR. It intelligently deploys funds into high-yield strategies:

Morpho Lending Pools: It seamlessly integrates with Morpho, depositing funds into lending pools to earn robust interest.


Yield Autocompound Pools: We're constantly evolving, with future support for autocompounding strategies that automatically reinvest yields, supercharging returns.

When the 

BetOracle confirms the event's outcome:

Your original bet is returned to you – guaranteed.

If you win, you receive a share of the substantial profits generated from our high-APR DeFi investments.

ZeroBlade isn't just about betting outcomes; it's about making your money work for you, securely and intelligently. Bet with confidence, knowing your principal is safe, and your potential rewards are maximized. Join ZeroBlade and experience the future of risk-free, yield-powered betting!
